package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// LearningTargetType describes the semantic shape of an opaque curriculum target.
// The target owner is deliberately not encoded as a service dependency.
type LearningTargetType string

const (
	LearningTargetConcept    LearningTargetType = "concept"
	LearningTargetCapability LearningTargetType = "capability"
)

// LearningTargetRef is a stable, provider-neutral reference. Version is optional
// because not every current curriculum source publishes graph/node versions yet.
type LearningTargetRef struct {
	Type    LearningTargetType `json:"type"`
	Key     string             `json:"key"`
	Version string             `json:"version,omitempty"`
}

// NormalizeLearningTargetRef validates one provider-neutral curriculum reference.
func NormalizeLearningTargetRef(target LearningTargetRef) (LearningTargetRef, error) {
	target.Key = strings.TrimSpace(target.Key)
	target.Version = strings.TrimSpace(target.Version)
	if !validLearningTargetType(target.Type) ||
		!validLearningValue(target.Key, 255) || len(target.Version) > 128 {
		return LearningTargetRef{}, errors.New("invalid learning target")
	}
	return target, nil
}

// NormalizeLearningTargetRefs validates one ordered task projection and rejects duplicates.
func NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(targets []LearningTargetRef) ([]LearningTargetRef, error) {
	if len(targets) > 100 {
		return nil, errors.New("too many learning targets")
	}
	result := make([]LearningTargetRef, len(targets))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
	for index, target := range targets {
		normalized, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRef(target)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid learning target at index %d: %w", index, err)
		}
		identity := string(normalized.Type) + "\x00" + normalized.Key + "\x00" + normalized.Version
		if _, duplicate := seen[identity]; duplicate {
			return nil, errors.New("duplicate learning target")
		}
		seen[identity] = struct{}{}
		result[index] = normalized
	}
	return result, nil
}

// LearningContextType identifies the product context without copying its entity.
type LearningContextType string

const (
	LearningContextGeneral      LearningContextType = "general"
	LearningContextLesson       LearningContextType = "lesson"
	LearningContextLessonTask   LearningContextType = "lesson_task"
	LearningContextPracticeTask LearningContextType = "practice_task"
	LearningContextProject      LearningContextType = "project"
)

// TeacherSupportContext records only whether the teacher supplied assistance.
// It does not assert that the learning action succeeded.
type TeacherSupportContext string

const (
	TeacherSupportIndependent TeacherSupportContext = "independent"
	TeacherSupportGuided      TeacherSupportContext = "guided"
)

// TeacherAssistanceObservationKind is intentionally bounded to teacher-owned
// facts. Mastery, success, failure, or task outcome are not valid values.
type TeacherAssistanceObservationKind string

const (
	TeacherObservationIndependentContext TeacherAssistanceObservationKind = "independent_context"
	TeacherObservationGuidedContext      TeacherAssistanceObservationKind = "guided_context"
	TeacherObservationHintUsed           TeacherAssistanceObservationKind = "hint_used"
	TeacherObservationIntervention       TeacherAssistanceObservationKind = "intervention"
)

// TeacherAssistanceObservation associates a teacher-owned fact with one target.
type TeacherAssistanceObservation struct {
	Target LearningTargetRef                `json:"target"`
	Kind   TeacherAssistanceObservationKind `json:"kind"`
}

// TeacherAssistance is the curated summary for exactly one learning action.
// Applying it never changes mastery directly.
type TeacherAssistance struct {
	EventID          string                         `json:"-"`
	StudentID        string                         `json:"-"`
	CorrelationID    string                         `json:"-"`
	CausationID      string                         `json:"-"`
	LearningActionID string                         `json:"learning_action_id"`
	ContextType      LearningContextType            `json:"context_type"`
	ContextID        string                         `json:"context_id,omitempty"`
	SupportContext   TeacherSupportContext          `json:"support_context"`
	HintsUsed        int                            `json:"hints_used"`
	MaxHintLevel     *int                           `json:"max_hint_level,omitempty"`
	InterventionUsed bool                           `json:"intervention_used"`
	Observations     []TeacherAssistanceObservation `json:"observations"`
	PolicyVersion    string                         `json:"policy_version"`
	OccurredAt       time.Time                      `json:"-"`
}

// NewTeacherAssistance validates and normalizes the consumer-owned projection input.
func NewTeacherAssistance(input TeacherAssistance) (TeacherAssistance, error) {
	input.EventID = strings.TrimSpace(input.EventID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.CorrelationID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CorrelationID)
	input.CausationID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CausationID)
	input.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningActionID)
	input.ContextID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ContextID)
	input.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PolicyVersion)
	input.OccurredAt = input.OccurredAt.UTC()

	if !validLearningUUID(input.EventID) || !validLearningUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!validLearningUUID(input.CorrelationID) || !validLearningUUID(input.CausationID) ||
		!validLearningUUID(input.LearningActionID) || input.CorrelationID != input.LearningActionID ||
		!validLearningActionContextType(input.ContextType) ||
		!validTeacherSupportContext(input.SupportContext) || !validLearningValue(input.PolicyVersion, 64) ||
		input.OccurredAt.IsZero() || input.HintsUsed < 0 || input.HintsUsed > 1000 ||
		len(input.Observations) == 0 || len(input.Observations) > 300 {
		return TeacherAssistance{}, errors.New("invalid teacher assistance")
	}
	if !validLearningUUID(input.ContextID) {
		return TeacherAssistance{}, errors.New("context_id is required for contextual teacher assistance")
	}
	if input.HintsUsed == 0 && input.MaxHintLevel != nil {
		return TeacherAssistance{}, errors.New("max_hint_level requires hints_used")
	}
	if input.HintsUsed > 0 && input.MaxHintLevel == nil {
		return TeacherAssistance{}, errors.New("max_hint_level is required when hints were used")
	}
	if input.MaxHintLevel != nil && (*input.MaxHintLevel < 0 || *input.MaxHintLevel > 7) {
		return TeacherAssistance{}, errors.New("max_hint_level must be between 0 and 7")
	}
	if input.SupportContext == TeacherSupportIndependent &&
		(input.HintsUsed != 0 || input.MaxHintLevel != nil || input.InterventionUsed) {
		return TeacherAssistance{}, errors.New("independent context cannot contain teacher assistance")
	}

	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input.Observations))
	type targetObservationSet struct {
		context      bool
		hint         bool
		intervention bool
	}
	perTarget := make(map[string]targetObservationSet, len(input.Observations))
	hasGuidance := false
	hasHintObservation := false
	hasInterventionObservation := false
	for index := range input.Observations {
		observation := &input.Observations[index]
		normalizedTarget, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRef(observation.Target)
		if err != nil || !validTeacherObservationKind(observation.Kind) {
			return TeacherAssistance{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid teacher assistance observation at index %d", index)
		}
		observation.Target = normalizedTarget

		if input.SupportContext == TeacherSupportIndependent && observation.Kind != TeacherObservationIndependentContext {
			return TeacherAssistance{}, errors.New("independent context accepts only independent observations")
		}
		if input.SupportContext == TeacherSupportGuided && observation.Kind == TeacherObservationIndependentContext {
			return TeacherAssistance{}, errors.New("guided context cannot contain independent observations")
		}
		switch observation.Kind {
		case TeacherObservationIndependentContext:
			facts := perTarget[learningObservationTargetIdentity(observation.Target)]
			facts.context = true
			perTarget[learningObservationTargetIdentity(observation.Target)] = facts
		case TeacherObservationGuidedContext:
			hasGuidance = true
			facts := perTarget[learningObservationTargetIdentity(observation.Target)]
			facts.context = true
			perTarget[learningObservationTargetIdentity(observation.Target)] = facts
		case TeacherObservationHintUsed:
			hasGuidance = true
			hasHintObservation = true
			facts := perTarget[learningObservationTargetIdentity(observation.Target)]
			facts.hint = true
			perTarget[learningObservationTargetIdentity(observation.Target)] = facts
		case TeacherObservationIntervention:
			hasGuidance = true
			hasInterventionObservation = true
			facts := perTarget[learningObservationTargetIdentity(observation.Target)]
			facts.intervention = true
			perTarget[learningObservationTargetIdentity(observation.Target)] = facts
		}

		key := string(observation.Target.Type) + "\x00" + observation.Target.Key + "\x00" + observation.Target.Version + "\x00" + string(observation.Kind)
		if _, duplicate := seen[key]; duplicate {
			return TeacherAssistance{}, errors.New("duplicate teacher assistance observation")
		}
		seen[key] = struct{}{}
	}

	if input.SupportContext == TeacherSupportGuided && !hasGuidance {
		return TeacherAssistance{}, errors.New("guided context requires a guidance observation")
	}
	if (input.HintsUsed > 0) != hasHintObservation {
		return TeacherAssistance{}, errors.New("hint aggregate does not match observations")
	}
	if input.InterventionUsed != hasInterventionObservation {
		return TeacherAssistance{}, errors.New("intervention aggregate does not match observations")
	}
	for _, facts := range perTarget {
		if !facts.context || facts.hint != (input.HintsUsed > 0) || facts.intervention != input.InterventionUsed {
			return TeacherAssistance{}, errors.New("teacher assistance facts must be complete for every target")
		}
	}
	return input, nil
}

func learningObservationTargetIdentity(target LearningTargetRef) string {
	return string(target.Type) + "\x00" + target.Key + "\x00" + target.Version
}

func validLearningUUID(value string) bool {
	_, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil
}

func validLearningValue(value string, max int) bool {
	return value != "" && len(value) <= max
}

func validLearningTargetType(value LearningTargetType) bool {
	return value == LearningTargetConcept || value == LearningTargetCapability
}

func validLearningContextType(value LearningContextType) bool {
	switch value {
	case LearningContextGeneral, LearningContextLesson, LearningContextLessonTask, LearningContextPracticeTask, LearningContextProject:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func validLearningActionContextType(value LearningContextType) bool {
	return value == LearningContextLessonTask ||
		value == LearningContextPracticeTask ||
		value == LearningContextProject
}

func validTeacherSupportContext(value TeacherSupportContext) bool {
	return value == TeacherSupportIndependent || value == TeacherSupportGuided
}

func validTeacherObservationKind(value TeacherAssistanceObservationKind) bool {
	switch value {
	case TeacherObservationIndependentContext, TeacherObservationGuidedContext, TeacherObservationHintUsed, TeacherObservationIntervention:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
